entities.summary: Mark Daniel Kolozsvary is an American professional baseball catcher in the Philadelphia Phillies organization. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Cincinnati Reds and Baltimore Orioles. He was drafted by the Reds in the seventh round of the 2017 MLB draft.
